requirement: A hidden lane is hidden the same way in the UI and through MCP

execution.commands: Paths in commands use STAGE_GATE for the supplied gate-slot.sh and CHECK_ROOT for a fresh isolated root. Run commands from the named scratch export. Heavy checks ran sequentially; every command has its own terminal result.
execution.browserSocketDirectory: Owned scratch directory, reached through the existing Linux proc alias helper.
execution.inputs: Scratch source exports with matching dependencies shared read-only. No live lane was hidden, shown or re-parked.

acceptance.requirement: MCP lists identify a hidden current decision
acceptance.evidence: src/lib/mcp/pipelineVisibility.integration.test.ts: compact, board-card, status-only and full-record list reads through the SDK, exported HTTP route, real service, schemas, policy and receipts on loopback port 0. Compact and board-card rows expose dismissedAt and hiddenFromBoard; full records retain dismissedAt.

acceptance.requirement: Retry after a provisioning park restores attention without a new round
acceptance.evidence: src/lib/mcp/pipelineVisibility.integration.test.ts: both base and worktree failure; pipeline_action Hide/Undo and dismiss_attention Hide; a second failure has no attempts, clears the stamp and attribution/note, returns to phone rows/badge and desktop laneNeed, then can be hidden again.

acceptance.requirement: The desktop honours Hide and can restore it
acceptance.evidence: src/components/kanban/kanbanBoard.browser.test.tsx: hidden lane visibility; real Viewer, a roundless fixture, card timeline and Undo menu, restored Needs-you row. Four locale/theme combinations at 1440x900, eight frames, fixed clock.

acceptance.requirement: Existing phone restore and engine guards remain valid
acceptance.evidence: The phone restore DOM case and engine dismissal case both pass; the latter checks cursor/runs/hosts and draft/closed refusals. MCP treats draft/closed lanes as already clear and leaves their record unchanged.

notes: Current-main regressions fail independently for missing list fields and retained dismissal after roundless re-park. These expected baseline failures are preserved.
Earlier draft/closed test attempts used an invalid fixture, then expected an error where MCP returns alreadyClear. Corrected tests use the real engine create/close output and assert no mutation.

The first Chromium probe and render failed before rendering because the socket path was too long. The existing ownedBrowserSocketEnvironment helper fixed the environment; one following render attempt corrected the pipeline timeline selector from need-cleared to lane-cleared.
ESLint reports zero errors and four warnings in existing code. No speed or memory improvement is claimed. Publication performs its own complete gate.
